title: fetch 与 pull 的真实语义（pull = fetch + merge / rebase）
expected_output:
拓扑: X -> A -> B(我的本地提交) / A -> C(队友已推到远端)
  main=d0bf96a  origin/main=1e940c8  remote(main)=fa807d0

=== 1) git fetch ===
  fetch 前: main=d0bf96a(feat: my local work) / origin/main=1e940c8(feat: add login)
  fetch 后: main=d0bf96a(feat: my local work) / origin/main=fa807d0(fix: teammate hotfix)
  本地分支指针移动: False
  工作区文件数变化: 0
  结论: fetch 只搬运对象并更新 refs/remotes/origin/*，本地分支与工作区一个字节都不动

=== 2) git pull（默认 pull.rebase=false => fetch + merge）===
  (1) fetch: origin/main -> fix: teammate hotfix
  merge-base(main, origin/main) = 1e940c8(feat: add login)
  可快进（main 是 origin/main 的祖先）: False
  merge 后 main=1ccf248(Merge branch 'main' of remote into main)
  merge commit 的 parent 数: 2
  可达提交数: 5
  历史线性: False

=== 3) git pull --rebase（fetch + rebase，同一份拓扑）===
  需重放的本地提交: ['feat: my local work']
  rebase 后 main=63fdad2(feat: my local work)
  原提交 commit 是否仍可达: False
  历史线性: True
  可达提交数: 4

对照结论: merge 保留真实分叉拓扑但引入 merge commit；rebase 历史线性却改写了本地提交 SHA
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""模型仓库：refs['main'] 本地分支，refs['origin/main'] 远端跟踪引用，remote['main'] 远端真实引用。"""
import zlib


def short(tag):
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(tag.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


class Repo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.parents, self.msg, self.refs, self.remote = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.worktree_files = 2

    def commit(self, msg, parents=()):
        cid = short(msg + "#" + ",".join(parents))
        self.parents[cid] = list(parents)
        self.msg[cid] = msg
        return cid

    def ancestors(self, start):
        seen, stack = set(), [start]
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            stack.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return seen

    def merge_base(self, a, b):
        anc = self.ancestors(a)
        q, seen = [b], set()
        while q:
            n = q.pop(0)
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            if n in anc:
                return n
            q.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return None

    def linear(self):
        return all(len(v) <= 1 for v in self.parents.values())


def scenario_fetch(r):
    before_main = r.refs["main"]
    before_track = r.refs["origin/main"]
    before_files = r.worktree_files
    r.refs["origin/main"] = r.remote["main"]
    print("=== 1) git fetch ===")
    print("  fetch 前: main=%s(%s) / origin/main=%s(%s)"
          % (before_main, r.msg[before_main], before_track, r.msg[before_track]))
    print("  fetch 后: main=%s(%s) / origin/main=%s(%s)"
          % (r.refs["main"], r.msg[r.refs["main"]], r.refs["origin/main"], r.msg[r.refs["origin/main"]]))
    print("  本地分支指针移动: %s" % (r.refs["main"] != before_main))
    print("  工作区文件数变化: %d" % (r.worktree_files - before_files))
    print("  结论: fetch 只搬运对象并更新 refs/remotes/origin/*，本地分支与工作区一个字节都不动")
    print()


def scenario_pull_merge(r):
    print("=== 2) git pull（默认 pull.rebase=false => fetch + merge）===")
    r.refs["origin/main"] = r.remote["main"]          # pull 的第一步就是 fetch
    print("  (1) fetch: origin/main -> %s" % r.msg[r.refs["origin/main"]])
    base = r.merge_base(r.refs["main"], r.refs["origin/main"])
    ff = r.refs["main"] in r.ancestors(r.refs["origin/main"])
    print("  merge-base(main, origin/main) = %s(%s)" % (base, r.msg[base]))
    print("  可快进（main 是 origin/main 的祖先）: %s" % ff)
    M = r.commit("Merge branch 'main' of remote into main", [r.refs["main"], r.refs["origin/main"]])
    r.refs["main"] = M
    print("  merge 后 main=%s(%s)" % (M, r.msg[M]))
    print("  merge commit 的 parent 数: %d" % len(r.parents[M]))
    print("  可达提交数: %d" % len(r.ancestors(M)))
    print("  历史线性: %s" % r.linear())
    print()


def scenario_pull_rebase(r):
    print("=== 3) git pull --rebase（fetch + rebase，同一份拓扑）===")
    locals_only = [c for c in [r.refs["main"]] if c not in r.ancestors(r.refs["origin/main"])]
    stack = []
    seen = set()
    frontier = [r.refs["main"]]
    while frontier:
        n = frontier.pop(0)
        if n in seen or n in r.ancestors(r.refs["origin/main"]):
            continue
        seen.add(n)
        stack.append(n)
        frontier.extend(r.parents.get(n, []))
    order = sorted(stack, key=lambda c: len(r.ancestors(c)))
    print("  需重放的本地提交: %s" % [r.msg[c] for c in order])
    tip = r.refs["origin/main"]
    for c in order:
        tip = r.commit(r.msg[c], [tip])
    r.refs["main"] = tip
    print("  rebase 后 main=%s(%s)" % (tip, r.msg[tip]))
    print("  原提交 commit 是否仍可达: %s" % any(c in r.ancestors(tip) for c in order))
    print("  历史线性: %s" % r.linear())
    print("  可达提交数: %d" % len(r.ancestors(tip)))
    print()


def build_repo():
    r = Repo()
    X = r.commit("chore: init")
    A = r.commit("feat: add login", [X])
    B = r.commit("feat: my local work", [A])
    C = r.commit("fix: teammate hotfix", [A])
    r.refs["main"] = B
    r.refs["origin/main"] = A
    r.remote["main"] = C
    return r


print("拓扑: X -> A -> B(我的本地提交) / A -> C(队友已推到远端)")
r0 = build_repo()
print("  main=%s  origin/main=%s  remote(main)=%s" % (r0.refs["main"], r0.refs["origin/main"], r0.remote["main"]))
print()

r_fetch = build_repo()
scenario_fetch(r_fetch)

r_merge = build_repo()
scenario_pull_merge(r_merge)

r_rebase = build_repo()
r_rebase.refs["origin/main"] = r_rebase.remote["main"]
scenario_pull_rebase(r_rebase)

print("对照结论: merge 保留真实分叉拓扑但引入 merge commit；rebase 历史线性却改写了本地提交 SHA")
